annotations.title: Risk ladder for a date and scenario

description: Annual risk of each level on a date between one year ago and one year ahead of the data date. Past dates use the published forecast archive; future dates use the scenario model and also return cumulative risk from the data date. Optional what-if assumptions.

hybrid_pct.description: What-if: annual probability of a destructive hybrid attack, %

regional_share_pct.description: What-if: share of attacks escalating into a regional war, %

scenario.description: optimistic | baseline | pessimistic, or a number from -1 to 1

scenario_factor.description: What-if: factor F by which intensity changes per year in the extreme scenarios

wide_share_pct.description: What-if: share of regional wars escalating into a wider war, %

name: get_risk_ladder
title: Risk ladder for a date and scenario
